in_sanskrit.name: Namisha
in_sanskrit.meaning: Name, fame, reputation, image, or repute
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who has a good name or reputation, one who is famous or renowned, one who is known by a good name, one who has a good image or repute, one who is respected and honored.

in_hindi.name: नामिशा
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who has God as her name or reputation, the one who is known by the name of God.

in_tamil.name: நாமிஷா
in_tamil.meaning: நாம் (ours) + ஷா (Sha, goddess of fertility and prosperity)
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who has the goddess of fertility and prosperity as her name or reputation, the one who is known by the name of our goddess.

in_telugu.name: నామిషా
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who has the goddess of power as her name or reputation, the one who is known by the name of power.

in_marathi.name: Namishaa
in_marathi.long_meaning: Namishaa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Named after the goddess Namishaa, meaning 'desirable' or 'wish-fulfilling'. In Hindu mythology, Namishaa is a form of the goddess Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth and prosperity. The name is believed to bring good fortune and blessings.

in_bengali.long_meaning: Namishaa একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Named after the goddess Namishaa, meaning 'desirable' or 'wish-fulfilling'.
